description:
Safe Genshin Impact mod with beautiful shaders, FPS unlocker, and 3DMigoto support.

Enhanced graphics, carefully crafted shaders, impressive FPS unlocking, and mods provide players with an even better gameplay experience than ever before. Rediscover the world of Teyvat with new visuals. A dedicated launcher streamlines the entire process, allowing players to jump into the action quickly and easily. Take your gameplay to the next level. Immerse yourself in the enhanced world of Teyvat and create unforgettable moments.
Released a completely new Stella Mod website - the biggest change to the website in its roughly 4-year history!
Miscellaneous
1. Updated Windows Terminal to the latest version.
2. Changed DpiMode from SystemAware to PerMonitorV2, which should improve UI rendering on screens with different resolutions.
3. Moved GitHub repositories to the Genshin Stella Mod organization.
4. Updated dependencies, including for FPS Unlocker.
5. Improved error diagnostics - crash messages now include more technical detail, making it easier to report issues.
6. This website (stella.sefinek.net) is now open source.
7. Fixed a bug where language settings might not save on the first launch of the Welcome App or Configuration Window if the application data folder did not yet exist.
8. Introduced log file rotation to prevent unlimited log growth.
Stella Mod Launcher
1. Fixed an issue that, in rare cases, caused Stella Mod Launcher to throw an unexpected error when closing the client.
2. Fixed known issues when updating Stella Mod.
3. Updated ReShade to the latest version.
Genshin Stella Mod
1. Fixed a bug where a failed injection of ReShade, FPS Unlocker, or 3DMigoto could be incorrectly reported as successful.
Prepare Stella Mod
1. Prepare Stella Mod now creates a backup of the existing ReShade.ini before overwriting it.
2. Improved the security of the process of downloading and extracting Stella Mod resources.
FPS Unlocker
1. NEW! FPS Unlocker now remembers the monitor by its unique identifier instead of only its position/index on the list - so if the order of connected monitors changes (e.g., unplugging and reconnecting a cable, using a docking station), the app will correctly select the same monitor and keep its settings (resolution, refresh rate).
2. Changed how the application requests administrator privileges on startup.
3. Changed the default fullscreen mode from Borderless to Exclusive - better compatibility with ReShade scaling and with monitors above FHD resolution.
4. Fixed a handle leak in the UnlockerStub.dll module when repeatedly restarting the game without restarting the application.
5. Fixed known issues.
> [!INFO]
> It is recommended to delete the unlocker.config.json file from data\dependencies\unlocker after updating.
Full Changelog: v8.10.1.0...v8.11.0.0
